title: LINUXDRV-002: PWM sysfs reads parse buffers with `atoi()` without adding a terminating NUL after `read()`
description:
LINUXDRV-002: PWM sysfs reads parse buffers with `atoi()` without adding a terminating NUL after `read()`. sysfs does not append NUL bytes, so parsing can read stale stack data past the bytes returned. Capture the read length, reject full-buffer reads, append `buf[n] = '\0'`, and use `strtol()` with validation. Next: revalidate historical evidence and assign a scoped repair task; no risk acceptance or closure is implied. Current audit reconciliation: Current shared sysfs reader reserves the terminator and NUL-terminates at the actual count; original unterminated-read shape is absent. Next: focused short/full read regression evidence and verified historical closure.
